name: AXIOM NETWORK SEVEN
description: Axiom's internal-facing entertainment and information network, broadcast across all Axiom-controlled residential and commercial territories via mandatory holographic display integration. Network Seven carries a blend of corporate lifestyle content, workforce motivation programming, approved news filtered through Axiom's communications division, and entertainment licensed from Vantablack under a bulk content agreement. Reception is automatic and non-optional in Axiom residential units; residents cannot disable the broadcast, only lower the volume.
cultural_impact: Normalized the concept of captive broadcast audiences within corponation residential territories, a model subsequently adopted or attempted by three other corponations.
story_hooks: An Axiom resident has found a technical method to substitute the Network Seven feed with Deadlight Mesh content through the same mandatory display hardware — and is quietly sharing the method with neighbors.

Network Seven's mandatory morning workforce motivation segment contains a phrase that, when heard repeatedly over months, triggers a documented neurological response in BCI users — whether this is intentional is unknown.
A content licensing dispute between Axiom and Vantablack has created a 48-hour gap in Network Seven's programming schedule — and someone has a plan for what to fill it with.
